topics.summary: The words Mockzilla uses, from simulation to replay.
topics.markdown:
# Terminology

A simulation is a mock API that Mockzilla runs for you.

## Simulation

One simulation serves one or more services. See [Simulation types](https://mockzilla.org/docs/simulations/simulation-types/) for the kinds there are.

# Simulation types

Every simulation starts from a spec.

## App simulations

An app simulation lives in your account. Back to [Terminology](https://mockzilla.org/docs/getting-started/terminology).
